g.text: Preview One Plan Argument and Admit Its Review - Target
No review waiting or completed plan.
Preview remains unsubmitted; no automatic repair or replay.
[P] = Pending implementation; existing two-phase plan events are reused.
Preview is not execution, validation or review admission.
Binding failure stops before the transaction.
Only the review transaction makes a plan actionable.
Approval and result return use the separate review sequence.
